versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious userinit.exe child process
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage: '*\userinit.exe'
filter:
    CommandLine:
        - '*\explorer.exe*'
        - '*\\netlogon\\*'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\userinit.exe" NOT (CommandLine IN ("*\\explorer.exe*", "*\\netlogon\\*"))

versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\userinit.exe" NOT CommandLine="*\\netlogon\\*" NOT Image="*\\explorer.exe"
